basic_info.description: Perched high above the city on a rare fully detached, double lot in Clarendon Heights, 34 Clarendon Ave offers sweeping panoramic views of the ocean, Golden Gate Bridge, and San Francisco skyline from every level. This 3,052 sq. ft. residence (per tax records) features 3 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms across a wide 50-foot frontage, creating a sense of scale and openness rarely found in the city. Floor-to-ceiling glass in the expansive great room frames the dramatic vistas, while a generous view terrace invites indoor-outdoor living. The well-appointed kitchen is outfitted with granite counters, double Miele ovens, Dacor gas cooktop, and Bosch dishwasher. The oversized primary suite and private guest suite on the lower level provide comfort and flexibility with an additional terrace attached to them, and large walk-in showers with floor to ceiling glass overlooking the trees. The home also includes a laundry room and multiple storage closets, and parking in the garage + driveway parking. Tucked in a peaceful hillside setting, 34 Clarendon is a rare blend of scale, light, and world-class views. Home is owner-occupied with many belongings and will not be staged, showings by appointment only.
